$comment: This Input Schema is part of A Example Pipeline for Unattended Pipelines, Data Transfer, and Computation Using Globus.  https://github.com/stanford-rc/globus-example-flow/tree/flow

source_data.title: Where is the source data to checksum?
source_data.description: A collection and path to a directory

cluster_temp.title: Where should the data be stored for processing?
cluster_temp.description: A collection and path to a directory

cluster_compute_endpoint.title: What is the unique ID of the cluster's Globus Compute endpoint?
cluster_compute_endpoint.description: This must match the location of cluster data storage!

function_id.title: What is the unique ID of the function to run?
function_id.description: The function must have been uploaded using the same Python version that your Compute Endpoint is running.

destination.title: Where should the results be delivered?
destination.description: A collection and path to a directory

path_prefix.title: What prefix should be used in directories we create?
path_prefix.description: Temporary and results directories will start with this string, and end with the Flow Run's unique ID.
